ITEM 1 | Cluster of bright red raspberries, slightly glossy, drupelet texture visible, a few with small white specks, covering roughly 15% of the plate in a loose mound about 9 cm across and 2 cm tall, sitting on the left side of the plate | 95
ITEM 2 | Dark purple-black blackberries, glossy with visible drupelets, scattered among the raspberries and as three loose berries near the top-left, each about 2 cm across, together covering roughly 6% of the plate | 45
ITEM 3 | Cubes and wedges of orange roasted vegetable with caramelized brown edges and dark charred spots, matte to slightly sticky surface, pieces about 2 to 3 cm across and 1 cm thick, spread in a loose scatter across the upper right of the plate covering roughly 18% of the plate | 110
ITEM 4 | Small pale yellow crumbly bits, possibly a grain or soft crumb, dry and matte, a few pieces about 0.5 cm, scattered among the orange pieces near the top right | 5
